annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence Strategy for the Digital Government
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence Strategy for the Digital Government
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agesic (Agencia de Gobierno Electrónico y Sociedad de la Información y del Conocimiento), Uruguay
annotation.summary_en: Uruguay's Agesic strategy for responsible AI use in Public Administration. It sets general principles (purpose, general interest, human rights, transparency, responsibility, ethics, added value) and four pillars: AI governance, capacity development, responsible use, and digital citizenship. It has no robotics or physical-AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: General objective: promote responsible use of AI in Public Administration
Principles: transparency, human rights, identifiable responsible person, ethical dilemmas resolved by humans
Algorithms, training data and validation tests should be made available
Four pillars: governance, capacity development, use and application, digital citizenship
Awareness campaigns to build citizen trust and knowledge of digital rights
